testName: Cart Management, Coupon Code Application & Multi-Step Checkout Flow
steps:
1. On Product Detail Page, click "Add to Cart" button
2. Verify mini-cart opens showing 1 item with subtotal
3. Click on "View Cart" button
4. In Promo Code input, enter "SUMMER10" and click Apply
5. Verify 10% promotional discount is deducted from order subtotal
6. Click on "Proceed to Checkout" button
7. In Shipping Step, select default saved warehouse address "Facility A - Warehouse"
8. In Payment Step, select Payment Method "Purchase Order (PO)" and enter PO Number "PO-2026-8819"
9. Click on "Place Order" button
10. Verify Order Confirmation screen loads with generated Order Summary Number
